name: Discrete Gaussian Curvature Estimation
definition: A Boolean operator used to classify surface vertices as elliptic (extremum) or hyperbolic (saddle) based on the sum of inner angles of adjacent faces relative to 2π.
summary: Discrete Gaussian Curvature Estimation classifies mesh vertices as elliptic or hyperbolic by comparing the sum of surrounding face angles to 2pi, distinguishing local extrema from saddle regions.
